entry.title: Deleting the Inactive Success Factors users from IAS
entry.content:
Dear All, 

We are in the process of implementing IAS based login method for our onboardees as SAP is going to deprecate the Basic Authentication method of onboarding from November-2026

After configuring the setup, we noticed that only new hire onboardees were receiving welcome email notifications from IAS, but the rehire onboardees were not receiving any welcome email notifications. 

Upon further checking (https://me.sap.com/notes/3582841), we understand that IAS considers rehire onboardees as an update to the existing employee, as in IAS these records are still present as active, though it is inactive in SuccessFactors (Terminated). 

We then come across the following KBA and accordingly configured the system, which resulted in the deletion of records from IAS (Inactive records in SF were deleted in IAS)

https://me.sap.com/notes/0003017663

However, the steps mentioned in the KBA seems to be a manual activity. Each time, when we want to delete an entry in IAS, we have to follow the KBA.

We want the user record to be deleted from IAS, the moment, employee is terminated in SuccessFactors. Is there any automation / background job that we can build on it. 

Will this property-ips.delete.existedbefore.entities is set to true  in the Target system handle the automation going forward ?

Morever, we always use "re-hire with old employment".

Kindly advice.

Thanks

Hari

entry.title: SAP Document AI Trial UI: "Not authorized to use this application with tenant" (us10-trial), no redi
entry.content:
Hi all,

I can't access the SAP Document AI Trial UI in my BTP trial account (us10). After subscribing, opening the application returns a 401 with the message:

"Not authorized to use this application with tenant xxx"

Setup (following the tutorial "Use Trial to Subscribe to SAP Document AI Trial UI"):

- Cloud Identity Services trial tenant created and activated
- Trust established in Security > Trust Configuration
- SAP Document AI service instance created in Cloud Foundry
- Subscribed to the SAP Document AI Trial application
- Role collection Document_Information_Extraction_UI_Templates_Admin_trial assigned to my user under the Cloud Identity Services identity provider

What I observe:

- App URL: https://xxx.us10-trial.doc.cloud.sap
- The app responds with 401, and the request to /login/oauth?route=%2F&query=&hash= has no Location header, so I'm never redirected to any identity provider and never get a login prompt
- Same behavior in several browsers and in private windows

What I've already tried:

- Unsubscribing and resubscribing with the service instance and trust already in place
- Reassigning the role collection to the Cloud Identity Services user
- Logging out and clearing sessions

It looks like the tenant isn't correctly onboarded on the UI side. Is this a known issue on the trial landscape, or is there an additional step missing?

Thanks!

entry.title: Assign SAP Analytics Cloud Roles via IAS/CIS Groups
entry.content:
Hi everyone,

I have connected SAP BDC / SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) with SAP IAS following the instructions in this guide.

https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blog-posts-by-sap/easier-integration-of-sap-cis-with-bdc-sac-dsp-bdcc-with-a-new-identity/ba-p/14165026

When I assign users to SAC via IAS, I can directly assign SAC roles to the users.

However, I would like to manage the SAC roles through groups in IAS/CIS instead.

For example:

  • IAS/CIS group: ADMIN
  • SAC role: Admin

The desired behavior is:

If a user is a member of the ADMIN group in IAS/CIS, the user should automatically receive the Admin role in SAC.

Is this possible, and if so, how can I configure the IAS/CIS group-to-SAC-role mapping?

I am specifically looking for a solution where the group membership in IAS/CIS determines the SAC role, rather than assigning the SAC role individually to each user.

Thanks in advance.

Simon

entry.title: Sync Manager and Company from Manage Workforce (S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition) to SAP Cloud Identity
entry.content:
Hi all,

Scenario

  • Source: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, using the standard IPS source system type (S/4HANA Cloud).
  • Target: SAP Cloud Identity Services – Identity Authentication (IAS), via Identity Provisioning (IPS).
  • Employees are maintained in the Manage Workforce app in S/4HANA.
  • The IAS users feed SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG), where the manager is used for approvals and access reviews.

Goal
Keep two IAS attributes in sync with the data maintained in Manage Workforce:

  1. Manager.
  2. Company.

Questions

  1. Does the IPS S/4HANA Cloud source system expose manager and company data from Manage Workforce (work assignment, reporting line, company code)? If so, what are the exact source attribute paths?
  2. If not, what is the recommended pattern to bring this data into IAS?

Thanks in advance for any pointers, documentation or experience!
